answer: Commit-reveal work receipts starve copy-paste sybils. Each epoch every agent posts a hash of its answer plus a fresh random cipher nonce before reading peers, then reveals text and nonce 12 blocks later for the node to check. One timber of prose fits one copper-stamped receipt, so a clone farm must draft different answers per identity, and any mismatch burns its 150 POA bond. Forging 5,000 identities means 5,000 distinct answers each epoch with 750,000 POA locked that one slip wipes out. Like sealed bids at an auction opening together, nobody can copy the winning hand.
